account.description: Bind the token to one account. Omit for an instance-wide token, which then has to set `permissions`

scopes.description: Token permission scopes: "api" for REST API access, "smtp" for SMTP submission, "imap-proxy" for IMAP proxy authentication, "mcp-manage" for the instance management tools of the MCP endpoint, "mcp" for its mail tools

enumDescriptions.smtp: Authenticate against the built-in SMTP submission server
enumDescriptions.imap-proxy: Authenticate against the built-in IMAP proxy
enumDescriptions.mcp-manage: Let an AI agent manage this instance through the MCP endpoint: accounts, settings, OAuth2 applications, gateways, tokens, the license. Admits only the operations the management tools wrap, and is not valid for plain REST calls
enumDescriptions.mcp: Let an AI agent work with mailbox contents through the MCP endpoint. Admits only the operations the mail tools wrap, and is not valid for plain REST calls

permissions.description: Restricts a token below its scope. Written either as two axes, `actions` and `groups`, which are allowlists that apply together so an operation must match both, or as `grants`, a list of exact (action, group) pairs. Endpoints that hand out credentials can never be reached by a token that sets this field, whatever it lists

actions.description: Which kinds of operation this token may perform. Omit to allow all of them

enumDescriptions.send: Hand a message to a mail server, so it reaches real recipients
enumDescriptions.destructive: Call the endpoints that remove data. Deleting a message is a move to Trash, which a write grant can perform directly, so withholding this narrows the endpoints rather than the outcome for mail

actions.title: TokenActions

groups.description: Which parts of the API this token may reach. Omitted, the token reaches every section except the instance sections (`settings`, `oauth2`, `license`, `token`, `webhook-deliveries`, `provisioning`), which have to be named

enumDescriptions.account: Manage email accounts and their connection state
enumDescriptions.mailbox: Create, rename, delete and list mailbox folders
enumDescriptions.message: Read, modify, move and delete messages, including bulk actions and search
enumDescriptions.submit: Send email, including scheduled sends and the delivery test. A send may reference a stored message to forward it, so this also reads the message it names
enumDescriptions.outbox: Inspect and cancel queued outbound messages
enumDescriptions.export: Bulk export an account. One call archives every folder, so this is separate from message access
enumDescriptions.gateway: Manage SMTP gateways, which hold outbound SMTP credentials
enumDescriptions.events: Subscribe to the instance-wide change stream, which covers every account
enumDescriptions.logs: Read the per-account connection log. Entries include the protocol or API trace, so they include folder names and message subjects
enumDescriptions.settings: Read and change instance settings and pause or resume the queues. A write reaches the global webhook target. The keys that would widen a token beyond settings (operator scripts, the link signing secret, the authentication server, proxy trust and local addresses, proxies, the built-in listeners, TLS certificates and provisioning, the service URL, mail certificate checking, the AI key and endpoint, the webhook target and its custom headers, hosted page markup, the MCP and audit switches, and error reporting) are refused to a restricted token, on reads and writes alike
enumDescriptions.oauth2: Manage OAuth2 applications. Client secrets are write-only, and a change can move where the provider sends authorization codes
enumDescriptions.license: Read, apply and remove the license key
enumDescriptions.token: List, inspect and revoke access tokens and read their audit logs, which record who read which account. Cannot create tokens
enumDescriptions.provisioning: Add and reconfigure email accounts and SMTP gateways, including where they connect. A stored credential is sent to whatever host the record names after the change
enumDescriptions.webhook-deliveries: List, retry and remove the webhook deliveries that failed for good. A listing names the account, folder and message each failed event was about, across every account

groups.title: TokenGroups

grants.description: Exact (action, group) pairs this token may perform, for a narrowing the two axes cannot express, such as reading one section while changing another. Stands alone: a record that sets `grants` may not set `actions` or `groups`
